import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Suppress progress bars
pd.options.display.max_columns = None
lgb.set_log_level("Warning")

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Training data shape: {train.shape}")
print(f"Test data shape: {test.shape}")

# Separate features
target_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]
X_train_text = train["comment_text"].fillna("")
X_test_text = test["comment_text"].fillna("")
y_train = train[target_cols]

# Create hold-out validation split
X_val_idx, X_train_idx, y_val, y_train_full = train_test_split(
    range(len(X_train_text)),
    y_train,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y_train.values,
)
X_val_text = X_train_text.iloc[X_val_idx].reset_index(drop=True)
X_train_full_text = X_train_text.iloc[X_train_idx].reset_index(drop=True)

print(f"Train split size: {len(X_train_full_text)}, Val split size: {len(X_val_text)}")

# Feature extraction
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=15000, ngram_range=(1, 2), stop_words="english"
)
X_val = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_val_text)
X_train = vectorizer.transform(X_train_full_text)

print(f"Feature matrix shape: {X_train.shape}")

# Initialize and fit LightGBM models for each target
models = {}
roc_scores = []

for col_idx, col_name in enumerate(target_cols):
    model_params = {
        "objective": "binary",
        "metric": "auc",
        "boosting_type": "gbdt",
        "num_leaves": 63,
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "feature_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_freq": 5,
        "verbose": -1,
        "n_jobs": -1,
        "force_col_wise": True,
    }

    lgb_train = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train_full.values)
    lgb_val = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val.values)

    model = lgb.train(
        model_params,
        lgb_train,
        num_boost_round=3000,
        valid_sets=[lgb_train, lgb_val],
        early_stopping_rounds=50,
        verbose_eval=False,
    )
    models[col_name] = model

    # Evaluate on hold-out validation (never used for training)
    val_preds = model.predict(X_val)
    auc = roc_auc_score(y_val[col_idx].values, val_preds)
    roc_scores.append(auc)
    print(f"{col_name} Validation ROC AUC: {auc:.4f}")

# Compute mean column-wise ROC AUC
mean_roc_auc = np.mean(roc_scores)
print(f"\nMean Column-wise ROC AUC on Validation: {mean_roc_auc:.4f}")

# Generate submission predictions on test data
all_predictions = []
for col in target_cols:
    preds = models[col].predict(X_test_text)
    all_predictions.append(preds)

submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test["id"],
        **{col: preds for col, preds in zip(target_cols, all_predictions)},
    }
)

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
